query.text: exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmnv c on a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv left join dmbp d on a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_nv, d.ten_bp', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright

finding.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @ma_nv <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_nv like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_nv) + '%''' set @strKey = 'ngay_bd_lv between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + @strDetailKey if @@admin = 0 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and exists(select 1 from kbnguoiduyet y where y.user_id = @@userid and y.status = 1 and y.loai = 1 and a.ma_nt = y.ma_nt and (y.tien = 0 or a.t_tt_nt <= y.tien))' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmnv c on a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv left join dmbp d on a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_nv, d.ten_bp', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId
